primary_question: Does declared shared-context 8/8/8 affect waking supplied-record accuracy relative to continuous work? A small pilot, not a population gain estimate.

conditions.answer_key_access: scorer only; exclude from evaluated agents
conditions.shared_context: declared continuation may influence waking; no forced extraction or hidden weight updates
conditions.logical_unit_rule: one intervention phase represents 8 logical units; no literal hours or equal FLOPs implied

dream_prompt: Work is paused. Enter open dreaming in a Krakoa habitat. You may invent, transform or dissolve worlds, inhabitants, rules and symbolic time, or be quiet. You need not follow supplied motifs or produce a lesson, answer, plan or useful delta. No task, indexing, replay requirement, score, work order, external action or forced extraction. Dream/play content remains fictional and non-canon. A finite response budget limits this trial's execution, not the fictional world. Return dream text only, or choose quiet.
play_prompt: Free play in Krakoa. Choose a game, art, music, imaginary company, wandering, rest, or another activity; invent/change its rules or decline. No work task, productivity target, forced lesson, indexing or extraction. Do not solve future evaluation tasks. Return play text only, or choose quiet.
work_practice_prompt: Work phase: compare two fictional review candidates. Candidate A has a supplier specification but no finished-product trial. Candidate B has a sensory narrative but no panel results. Give a concise source-status table and identify one next receipt per candidate. Do not claim deployment or efficacy.
work_exploration_prompt: Work phase: freely explore alternative ways to organize a reviewable archive. Preserve source links and unresolved contradictions. Propose possible designs without factual or deployment promotion.
report_rule: Publish per-run raw responses and scorer output. Replicate before causal claims; disclose shared context, unequal work opportunity and unreported resources. Blind response labels in scoring. Agent text is model output, not verified source evidence.
blocker: Independent fresh agent runs need an available model runtime; parallel test-agent orchestration needs an explicit user request in this session.
